messages:
jamal: ci-bot just flagged a red on full-integ for hosted API (shard=12). failing tests: auth_stream_handshake.test, toolcall_schema_validation.test
ci-bot: [FAIL] auth_stream_handshake.test (shard=12)
ci-bot: log excerpt: "ERR 401 Unauthorized - token rotate mismatch"
ci-bot: [FAIL] toolcall_schema_validation.test -> payload mismatch: expected field 'tool_args' array, got object
alex: ugh. repro locally or only CI?
jamal: only seeing it in CI so far. quick grep shows the handshake uses rotated-token header logic from #3142 which merged yesterday (maria's PR).
maria: that PR touched session rotation code but I ran unit tests. didn't hit integ. could be an ordering/timing issue when streaming starts and auth refresh races.
anya: can we rerun the shard first to rule out transient?
jamal: yes doing now: @ci-bot please rerun job full-integ/shard-12 (triggered-by jamal)
ci-bot: rerun queued +1 (job id 98765). will post status.
[~10m later]
ci-bot: rerun finished -> still failing same two tests on shard-12
alex: ok not transient. next step bisect commit range since PR landed yesterday. jamal — can you grab green->red commit window?
jamal: green at 1833920000, red after merge of maria's #3142 (commit d4f7ac9). suspect range d4f7ac9..HEAD (includes hotfixes).
anya: I can bisect. plan: git bisect start HEAD d4f7ac9^ ; run full-integ (shard-12 subset) until we find the culprit. someone to babysit infra?
devops-bot: heads up — running full-integ on older commits may require setting AUTH_ROTATE_ENABLED=1 in env to match prod rollout. also tests expect schema v2; if you switch commit you might need TEST_SCHEMA_VERSION=2 for consistency.
maria: noted. my change toggles rotate logic behind AUTH_ROTATE_ENABLED, but default in CI is true. weird that older commits might differ.
alex: for speed, run only the two failing tests first: pytest tests/integration/auth_stream_handshake.py::test_handshake -k "shard12" --run-slow
anya: starting bisect now. will post commit ids as I go.
[~25m later]
anya: git bisect landed on commit 7c9a2b3 — it introduces a small reordering in session manager: move rotateToken call earlier in stream init.
anya: reproduces locally when running with AUTH_ROTATE_ENABLED=1 against hosted-staging. error: streaming handshake returns 401 intermittently, and toolcall test fails with schema validation path: serializer applied before tool args coercion.
maria: that's the change. I moved rotate earlier to avoid a race I saw with long-lived sessions, but didn't realize it affected initial handshake ordering. good find.
jamal: can we quick revert in CI until we ship coordinated fix? maybe pin to previous behavior for hosted tests only (set TEST_SCHEMA_VERSION=1 on CI for now) or revert the reorder.
maria: I'll open a revert PR to restore previous order and add regression integ tests for both cases. will target a fast revert and then a proper fix with a guard.
alex: for rollback plan: revert PR #3142, run full-integ on shard-12, if green merge revert. jamal — can you queue the revert PR as urgent?
jamal: on it, creating PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/3290 (revert of #3142). tagging @maria @anya for review.
ci-bot: PR created by jamal: #3290. CI will run presubmit.
[~5m later]
ci-bot: presubmit results: presubmit passed on linux, mac; integration presubmit queued (will run shard subset).
anya: thanks — I'll watch the integration shard. also adding a short note in the oncall doc about temporary pin to prevent customer impact.
maria: sorry for churn, adding regression test + comment. then will rework rotate to avoid this ordering break.
alex: sounds good. jamal — please post final status once revert merges or if presubmit fails.
jamal: ack. @devops-bot can you add a one-off job to rerun full-integ/shard-12 after the revert merges?
devops-bot: scheduled: rerun full-integ/shard-12 after merge of #3290.
anya: leaving a checklist here: [x] bisect -> found commit 7c9a2b3, [x] open revert PR #3290, [ ] wait presubmit + integ, [ ] merge revert, [ ] confirm green, [ ] reopen proper fix PR with regression tests.
jamal: thanks team. will update when CI gives us final green or if anything else pops up. :thumbsup:
alex: cheers. :coffee:
maria: thx all.
ci-bot: final note: customers unaffected; failures are in CI-only test harness.
